order_note: No predecessor and no ordering constraint. SQL 126 replaces thirteen functions restored from the supabase migrations (spec prerequisites, with the helpers they call: auth.uid(), public.is_platform_owner(), public.aws_can_access_tenant(uuid), public.aws_can_access_check(uuid), public.aws_user_tenant_ids(), public.has_role(uuid, public.app_role), public.user_belongs_to_tenant(uuid, uuid), the tables and views their bodies read, and role checksops; a read-only production inspect confirms them). Each must be owned by the applying login (functions_owned_by_login), keep its result type (function_results_match) and hold no EXECUTE grant other than PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role, checksops and the owner (function_acl_replaceable). The API gates of PR #1379 (aws/functions/api/data.mjs RPC_ACCESS_GATES) stay as they are; no API or SPA change is needed (the API already refuses what the functions now refuse). Adds no trigger: the DB validator's public trigger count is not affected.
